title: Reproducibility code and data for "On the sum of a prime and a square-free number coprime to integers with at most five prime factors"
description: Code and data for the computations in the paper "On the sum of a prime and a square-free number coprime to integers with at most five prime factors" by W. Hoare, E. S. Lee and A. Pearce-Crump: the exact criterion for 108 ≤ n ≤ 10<sup>4</sup> (Threshold.py), the C++ verifiers and their results for 10<sup>4</sup> < n ≤ 2·10<sup>12</sup>, and the explicit constants of Tables 1 and 2 (streamlined_tables.py).
keywords: prime number theorem for arithmetic progressions
